title: Nashville Bound!!  3 Bed/2 Bath
description:
This 1950's home is located in the heart of Donelson surrounded by lots of greenery and a nice backyard.  Donelson has become one of the fastest growing cities in Nashville and has great places to eat and to be entertained.  In addition to the great town of Donelson our home is only seven miles from downtown Nashville where many come to visit, work and have family gatherings.  Our home is ideal for any of these occasions as it is fully stocked as if you are walking into your own home.

The space
3 bed/2 bath with entertainment room (play a guitar, nice bar and Battle Toss), small porch with grill.  All new furnishings throughout the house and plenty of beds for all types of groups.  Two bedrooms with Queen size beds, one bedroom has a Full/Twin Custom bunk bed.  Sofa sleeper is Queen size and a futon is in the entertainment room.

Other things to note
Also, the Donelson area, in which you are staying has some really awesome spots to check out and eat during your stay.
